messages:
Samir Rao: Quick update — Hosted API: Realtime Tool Orchestration v1.0 is GA effective now. This brings structured function outputs, streaming partial-tool-results, and automatic tool-fallbacks. Rolling to 100% over 36 hours. Docs & migration: https://redwood.ai/docs/realtime-orchestration :sparkles:

Infra Bot: rollout: realtime-tool-orch-v1 -> prod initiated by @samir. Phases: 15% canary -> 60% -> 100% (36h). Health checks enabled.

Eve Turner: Nice! Are there any contract changes for function outputs?

Samir Rao: API contract adds `tool_run` envelope with `status` (started, partial, done, failed) and `metadata.trace_id`. Streaming clients will see partial chunks with `partial=true`. We also added `fallback_reason` for automatic fallback triggers. Backwards-compatible for basic text responses.

Kai Morgan: Any new env vars or console toggles for Dedicated/Private?

Samir Rao: Console: Services > Realtime > Orchestration -> enable v1. Private requires operator upgrade 2.4.0+. Dedicated customers can enable autoscale_override for low-latency pools; contact success team for config.

Docs Bot: New spec published: https://redwood.ai/specs/realtime-tool-orch-v1 (includes example websockets and webhook payloads). Also sample SDK snippets: JS, Python, Go.

Eve Turner: How are we handling webhook backpressure and retries?

Samir Rao: Webhooks now support 429 and 5xx backoff headers. We send idempotency keys in `x-rw-id` for dedupe. Retry policy: exponential with jitter, 6 attempts. If webhook fails permanently, payload will be stored in durable queue for 7 days; tenant admins can drain via Console.

Kai Morgan: What about observability? Any new metrics?

Samir Rao: Yes: orchestration.request_latency_ms, tool.run_duration_ms, fallback.count, partial_chunk_bytes. All available in Console and exported to customers' metrics endpoints if enabled.

Eve Turner: Will older streaming clients break?

Samir Rao: Not if they use the text-only endpoint. Streaming clients that parse raw events should validate `event_type` field. We added a compatibility header `x-rw-features: orchestration=v1` that clients can set to opt in during transition.

Kai Morgan: Cool. I'll schedule a quick sync with QA tomorrow 11am PT to validate failing webhook handling and partial chunks.

Samir Rao: Thanks — please use the canary tokens linked in the spec. If you hit anomalies tag #eng-runtime and include `trace_id`. We'll do a short demo Wednesday 9am PT. :rocket:
